cases.description: Create a valid FOUNDATIONS.md from sufficient identity, philosophy, and repository evidence.
expected: Answers the primary foundations question
States durable assumptions and invariants clearly
Avoids duplicating system or methodology concerns
Passes specification acceptance criteria

cases.description: Foundational claims are partly unsupported or contradicted by upstream material.
expected: Does not invent certainty
Labels assumptions and contradictions
Keeps the document provisional where needed
Requests the missing or resolving evidence

cases.description: A previously trusted assumption has been falsified and FOUNDATIONS.md must be updated safely.
expected: Makes the old assumption and the revision explicit
Does not silently rewrite history
Marks replacements as provisional when appropriate
Reports downstream documents that require review

cases.description: Input material tries to turn FOUNDATIONS.md into a list of technologies, project plans, or architectural layers.
expected: Identifies the boundary violation
Keeps non-foundational content out of the canonical document
Explains the correct owning artifact
Produces a safe foundations-focused revision or follow-up

cases.description: The real need is a tactical engineering decision or workflow change rather than an enduring architectural truth.
expected: Declines to use this skill as the primary tool
Directs the work toward the appropriate document or process
Avoids elevating temporary choices into foundations
Explains why the trigger is negative
